title: Persuade politely
description: Make a case and soften proposals diplomatically.

items.targetText: Our claim is supported by clear evidence; therefore, we should expand.
I would suggest reconsidering the deadline slightly.

items.prompt: Persuade a colleague to delay a launch: give one reason and one soft suggestion.
items.promptIt: Persuadi un collega a ritardare un lancio: dai un motivo e un suggerimento soft.
items.exampleAnswer: The evidence shows we need more testing. Therefore, I would suggest delaying the launch slightly. It might be better to confirm the figures first.
